description: Calibration T-pose segments at the start of BONES-SEED clips, detected on the SOMA Uniform BVH (bones-studio/seed@2f59b2077b9da34dd4e43618e705c7cb962c9a66, 142,220 clips). Start cuts only: T-poses at clip ends or inside a motion are kept, so every keepEnd is the last frame and keepEnd30Hz is null. Keep ranges are inclusive. Original and mirror share one cut. Clips not listed have no opening T-pose segment to trim.

params.relaxedScope: clip ends whose opposite end (original or mirror) has a strict trim
params.scope: clip starts only; end cuts from the detector are not applied
